## Required for KSA 2026.10.7.5541
The stock flight computer now ends auto burns itself: it removes a finished burn when another one follows, loads the next one, stops time warp, and stops an auto burn whose engines run dry. Update is mandatory for this mod to work if you are on KSA version 2026.10.7.5541 and above; without it a planned burn can be lost after an auto burn, AutoStage and multi-pass burns lose their burn, and RCS burns fail to load.

## Changes
- AutoRemove, multi-pass burns and RCS burns follow the stock end of an auto burn, so no planned burn is removed twice. AutoRemove now only removes the last finished burn, which the game keeps.
- RCS burns end like engine burns: the stock alert, warp stop and the next burn loaded in Manual.
- AutoStage keeps an auto burn running across its own staging and across a staging by hand, and a staging no longer leaves a frame without thrust.
- A multi-pass burn whose vessel has no propellant left cancels with an alert instead of waiting.
- Guidance plans within the game's structural g-force limit: UPFG, G-FOLD and the convex ascent keep the acceleration below the lower of your g-limit and the limit the game now enforces on the throttle.
- The Transfer Planner integration follows the new stock Interstellar plan type, and the comet encounter fix works with the new encounter search.
- For other mods: the public `RcsBurnCompletions` event is removed; an RCS burn now raises the stock `FlightComputer.AutoBurnCompleted` flag.
